body:
Hi!

Me and a bunch of other people have made maps, and they are all sitting in the map release section of the forums. When will our maps be accepted or denied?


-EDJM9

title: When will the Map Devs view our maps?

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body: This is ask the seniors.... The Mapdevs are busy converting current maps to XML in order to meet deadlines to push Atlas out. But I'm sure they will review some of the maps very soon.
